name: TickerK8 PRE ALPHA 0.0.3.129
body:
NEW RELEASE

We want introduce you new version of application. 
What's changed? 

1. Login page

    *  New dynamic background
    *  New design and layout
    
2. Register page

    *  Creation a register page
    *  Creation a register script

3. Main page

    *  New dynamic background
    *  New design and layout
    *  Creation user list side
    *  Creation list control, user can edit what type of data  will be displayed and which list will be showed
    *  Creation data windows of objects like icon, name, ticker, statistics, chart, info 
    *  Creation news side, window with five hot news from user region
    *  Creation  news control, user can see list of news from: market, country, world after pressing button
    *  Creation news window
    *  Creation search window, user can search object in database and add to his lists
    *  Creation settings window
